name: Silverpine Forest
summary: Silverpine Forest lies under Forsaken rule and threat from rival forces along Lordaeron's western coast. The Scourge's plague scars the woods, where worgen, diseased gnolls, and hostile human enclaves endanger travelers.

sections.title: A Haunted Frontier
sections.body: Silverpine Forest lies between Tirisfal Glades and the sealed Greymane Wall. Once a lush wonder of Lordaeron, it has withered since the Third War. Ghostly fog moves among dying, silver-barked pines, and ruined farmsteads lie abandoned to the wilderness. Tirisfal Glades borders the forest to the north, and Lordamere Lake lies along its eastern shore. To the south, the Greymane Wall shuts Gilneas away from the chaos beyond. The Forsaken hold their central outpost at the Sepulcher and struggle to secure the woods from enemies on every side.

sections.title: Rival Enclaves and the Scourge
sections.body: The Forsaken's claim to Silverpine faces challenges from living and undead factions. On Fenris Isle to the east, Thule Ravenclaw leads Scourge remnants and commands plague-addled Rot Hide gnolls that trouble the northern farmlands. In the south, human mages from Dalaran hold the fortified settlement of Ambermill, where they conduct mystical research and oppose Forsaken expansion. At the Sepulcher, the Royal Apothecary Society and High Executor Hadrec wage a brutal campaign against these threats while testing virulent new plagues.

sections.title: The Worgen and Shadowfang
sections.body: Shadowfang Keep looms above Silverpine's southwest woods, held by the mad Dalaran archmage Arugal. The keep was once Baron Silverlaine's seat. During the Third War, Arugal summoned wolf-beasts from another dimension to repel the Scourge. The beasts turned on their summoners and spread a lycanthropic curse through the southern woods. By daylight, human villagers in Pyrewood Village appear ordinary and go about their chores. Beneath the night sky, they transform into savage worgen.

faq.q: What is the Greymane Wall at the southern border?
aliases: why is there a giant wall
faq.answer: The Greymane Wall is a massive stone barrier built by King Genn Greymane to isolate Gilneas from the rest of Lordaeron. When the Scourge ravaged the continent during the Third War, Gilneas shut its gates and refused outside aid, leaving lands north of the wall, including southern Silverpine, to fend for themselves.

faq.q: Why do the villagers of Pyrewood Village attack at night?
aliases: why are pyrewood humans hostile at night
faq.answer: Archmage Arugal's worgen curse afflicts the inhabitants of Pyrewood Village. By day, they keep human form and their daily routines, remaining friendly to the Alliance. When the moon rises, the curse transforms the villagers into savage, bloodthirsty worgen who attack anyone nearby.

Thule Ravenclaw is a powerful necromancer serving the Scourge. From Fenris Keep on Fenris Isle in Lordamere Lake, he commands legions of undead and influences the diseased Rot Hide gnolls across eastern Silverpine, threatening the Forsaken's eastern flank.

aliases: why is the alliance in ambermill
faq.answer: Wizards of Dalaran led by Archmage Ataeric hold Ambermill. From the village, these human mages monitor Forsaken movements, study the forest's magical afflictions, and seek to contain the nearby worgen outbreak spreading from Shadowfang Keep.

The Sepulcher is the Forsaken's main military outpost and travel hub in Silverpine Forest. Under High Executor Hadrec, it is the base for Deathguard patrols, Deathstalker scouts, and the Royal Apothecary Society as they fight to secure the forest.

faq.q: Can Alliance players quest in Silverpine Forest?
faq.answer: Silverpine Forest has no Alliance gathering places or friendly towns; local work is for the Horde alone. Alliance adventurers usually enter the forest while traveling from Southshore to explore Shadowfang Keep or fight hostile Forsaken forces.

angles.text: Silverpine is the Forsaken's front line south of Tirisfal Glades. The Royal Apothecary Society tests new concoctions here, while the Deathguard battles lingering Scourge agents.
Alliance explorers find a hostile forest, with only a fragile Dalaran garrison at Ambermill and the cursed villagers of Pyrewood Village.
Ambermill and the fall of Archmage Arugal into lupine madness make Silverpine a grim warning of Kirin Tor magic gone disastrously astray.
